title: Exact Sequence Interpolation with Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2502.02270v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We prove that transformers can exactly interpolate datasets of finite input sequences in $\mathbb{R}^d$, $d\geq 2$, with corresponding output sequences of smaller or equal length. Specifically, given $N$ sequences of arbitrary but finite lengths in $\mathbb{R}^d$ and output sequences of lengths $m^1, \dots, m^N \in \mathbb{N}$, we construct a transformer with $\mathcal{O}(\sum_{j=1}^N m^j)$ blocks and $\smash{\mathcal{O}(d \sum_{j=1}^N m^j)}$ parameters that exactly interpolates the dataset. Our construction provides complexity estimates that are independent of the input sequence length, by alternating feed-forward and self-attention layers and by capitalizing on the clustering effect inherent to the latter. Our novel constructive method also uses low-rank parameter matrices in the self-attention mechanism, a common feature of practical transformer implementations. These results are first established in the hardmax self-attention set

translated_abstract: 我们证明了Transformer能够精确插值由 $\mathbb{R}^d$（$d\geq 2$）中有限输入序列及其对应的不超过输入长度的输出序列组成的数据集。具体而言，给定 $N$ 个在 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 中长度任意但有限的序列，以及长度为 $m^1, \dots, m^N \in \mathbb{N}$ 的输出序列，我们构造了一个具有 $\mathcal{O}(\sum_{j=1}^N m^j)$ 个块和 $\mathcal{O}(d \sum_{j=1}^N m^j)$ 个参数的Transformer，可以对该数据集实现精确插值。我们的构造通过交替使用前馈层和自注意力层，并利用自注意力层固有的聚类效应，提供了与输入序列长度无关的复杂度估计。我们新颖的构造方法还在自注意力机制中使用了低秩参数矩阵，这也是实际Transformer实现中的一个常见特征。这些结果首先在hardmax自注意力设定下建立。
tldr: 该论文通过交替使用前馈层与自注意力层并采用低秩参数矩阵，证明了Transformer能够以与输入序列长度无关的复杂度精确插值有限序列数据集。
